title: EIP-7951: Precompile for secp256r1 Curve Support

sub_graphs.name: P256VERIFY Precompile Interface
sub_graphs.description: Defines the P256VERIFY precompile at address 0x100 for ECDSA signature verification over the secp256r1 (P-256) elliptic curve with a gas cost of 6900.

invariants.text: The precompile MUST reside at address 0x100.
The precompile MUST consume exactly 6900 gas regardless of input validity or verification outcome.
The precompile MUST NOT revert under any circumstances.
Gas is burned on error: invalid inputs or verification failures MUST return empty bytes and consume the same gas as a successful verification.

preconditions.text: Input MUST be exactly 160 bytes: 32 bytes message hash h, 32 bytes r, 32 bytes s, 32 bytes qx, 32 bytes qy.

postconditions.text: On failure (invalid input or failed verification), output is empty bytes (0 bytes).

functions.signature: P256VERIFY(h: bytes32, r: bytes32, s: bytes32, qx: bytes32, qy: bytes32) -> bytes32 | empty
functions.description: Precompile entry point accepting 160-byte concatenated input for secp256r1 ECDSA signature verification.

sub_graphs.name: secp256r1 Curve Parameters
sub_graphs.description: Defines the NIST P-256 (secp256r1) elliptic curve parameters including base field modulus, curve coefficients, base point, subgroup order, and cofactor.

invariants.text: Curve parameters are fixed as standardized by NIST SP 800-186: p, a, b, Gx, Gy, n, h.
The cofactor h = 1, meaning the base point generates the entire curve group.

sub_graphs.name: Input Validation Logic
sub_graphs.description: Defines the mandatory validation checks performed on the precompile input before signature verification.

invariants.text: All five validation checks MUST pass before verification proceeds; failure of any check MUST return empty bytes.

preconditions.text: Input length MUST be exactly 160 bytes.
Signature components: 0 < r < n AND 0 < s < n.
Public key coordinates: 0 <= qx < p AND 0 <= qy < p.
Point validity: qy^2 ≡ qx^3 + a*qx + b (mod p).
Point not at infinity: (qx, qy) MUST NOT be (0, 0).

sub_graphs.name: ECDSA Signature Verification Algorithm
sub_graphs.description: The core ECDSA verification algorithm for secp256r1: computes s^(-1) mod n, recovers point R', checks it is not the point at infinity, and verifies R'.x ≡ r (mod n).

invariants.text: The comparison MUST use modular reduction: R'.x ≡ r (mod n), not direct equality. This is a security fix over RIP-7212.
If the recovered point R' is the point at infinity, the precompile MUST return empty bytes. This is a security fix over RIP-7212.

preconditions.text: All input validation checks from SG-7951-003 must have passed.

postconditions.text: Returns 1 (as 32-byte big-endian) if R'.x ≡ r (mod n); returns empty bytes otherwise.

functions.description: s1 = s^(-1) mod n; R' = (h * s1) * G + (r * s1) * Q; check R' != infinity; return R'.x ≡ r (mod n).

sub_graphs.name: Point and Scalar Encoding
sub_graphs.description: Defines encoding rules for field elements, curve points, the point at infinity, and scalars used in the precompile ABI.

invariants.text: Field elements are encoded as 32-byte big-endian unsigned integers and MUST be less than p.
Points are encoded as 64-byte concatenation of x and y field element encodings.
The point at infinity is encoded as 64 zero bytes.
Scalars are encoded as 32-byte big-endian unsigned integers and are NOT required to be less than n.
Invalid encodings of field elements or points MUST cause the precompile to return empty bytes.

data_structures.name: Scalar
data_structures.definition: 32-byte big-endian unsigned integer (no upper bound constraint)

sub_graphs.name: Security Properties
sub_graphs.description: Captures the security considerations including signature malleability, side-channel resistance, and the two critical security fixes over RIP-7212.

invariants.text: secp256r1 ECDSA signatures are NOT required to be non-malleable; applications requiring non-malleability must implement additional checks at the application layer.
The precompile IS NOT REQUIRED to use constant-time algorithms for side-channel resistance.
Security fix 1 (vs RIP-7212): The recovered point R' MUST be checked for point-at-infinity to prevent non-deterministic behavior and consensus failures.
Security fix 2 (vs RIP-7212): Comparison MUST use r' ≡ r (mod n) instead of r' == r to handle x-coordinates exceeding the curve order.

sub_graphs.name: Backwards Compatibility with RIP-7212
sub_graphs.description: Defines interface compatibility with RIP-7212 deployed on Layer 2 networks, noting same address, input/output format, but different gas cost.

invariants.text: Same precompile address as RIP-7212: 0x100.
Same input format (160 bytes) and output format (32 bytes or empty) as RIP-7212.
Gas cost differs: 6900 gas (EIP-7951) vs 3450 gas (RIP-7212).

sub_graphs.name: Blob Schedule Configuration (EIP-7892)
sub_graphs.description: Defines the blob schedule for Fulu, specifying maximum blobs per block limits at given epochs. Enables blob-parameter-only hardforks without full consensus upgrades.

invariants.text: There MUST NOT exist multiple blob schedule entries with the same epoch value.
Each entry's epoch MUST be >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH.
Each entry's max_blobs_per_block MUST be <= MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK.
The blob schedule entries SHOULD be sorted by epoch in ascending order.

data_structures.name: BlobParameters
data_structures.definition: @dataclass class BlobParameters: epoch: Epoch; max_blobs_per_block: uint64

sub_graphs.name: get_blob_parameters Helper
sub_graphs.description: Returns the active BlobParameters for a given epoch by scanning the blob schedule in reverse epoch order. Falls back to Electra defaults if no matching entry is found.

invariants.text: The function MUST return the blob parameters entry with the highest epoch that is <= the queried epoch.
If no schedule entry matches, the function MUST return BlobParameters(ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH, MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK_ELECTRA) as fallback.

preconditions.text: The BLOB_SCHEDULE configuration must be available.

postconditions.text: Returns a BlobParameters with epoch <= queried epoch and the corresponding max_blobs_per_block.

functions.description: Return the blob parameters at a given epoch. Scans BLOB_SCHEDULE sorted by epoch descending, returns first match where epoch >= entry epoch. Falls back to Electra defaults.

sub_graphs.name: Modified process_execution_payload (EIP-7892)
sub_graphs.description: The execution payload processing function modified in Fulu to use dynamic blob limits from get_blob_parameters instead of a static constant.

invariants.text: payload.parent_hash MUST equal state.latest_execution_payload_header.block_hash.
payload.prev_randao MUST equal get_randao_mix(state, get_current_epoch(state)).
payload.timestamp MUST equal compute_time_at_slot(state, state.slot).
len(body.blob_kzg_commitments) MUST be <= get_blob_parameters(get_current_epoch(state)).max_blobs_per_block (modified in Fulu:EIP7892).
The execution engine MUST verify and notify new payload successfully via verify_and_notify_new_payload.

preconditions.text: A valid BeaconState and BeaconBlockBody must be provided.

postconditions.text: state.latest_execution_payload_header is updated to the ExecutionPayloadHeader derived from the payload.

functions.signature: process_execution_payload(state: BeaconState, body: BeaconBlockBody, execution_engine: ExecutionEngine) -> None
functions.description: Verifies execution payload consistency (parent_hash, prev_randao, timestamp), checks blob commitment count against dynamic blob limit, verifies payload with execution engine, and caches the execution payload header.

sub_graphs.name: Modified compute_fork_digest (EIP-7892)
sub_graphs.description: Fork digest computation modified to incorporate blob parameters into the digest, enabling blob-parameter-only forks to produce distinct fork digests for p2p domain separation.

invariants.text: The fork digest MUST incorporate the blob parameters (epoch and max_blobs_per_block) via XOR with the hash of the encoded blob parameters.
The fork digest MUST be 4 bytes (truncated from the XOR result).
Changes to blob schedule parameters at a given epoch MUST produce a different fork digest, ensuring p2p layer domain separation.

preconditions.text: genesis_validators_root and epoch must be provided.

postconditions.text: Returns a 4-byte ForkDigest that is unique per fork version AND blob parameters.

functions.description: Computes base fork digest from fork version and genesis_validators_root, then XORs with hash(uint_to_bytes(blob_params.epoch) + uint_to_bytes(blob_params.max_blobs_per_block)), and truncates to 4 bytes.

sub_graphs.name: Extended BeaconState with Proposer Lookahead (EIP-7917)
sub_graphs.description: The BeaconState container is extended with a proposer_lookahead field, a vector of validator indices covering (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1) * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH slots starting from the current epoch.

invariants.text: proposer_lookahead length MUST be (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1) * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH.
proposer_lookahead[0] corresponds to the first slot of the current epoch.
Each entry in proposer_lookahead MUST be a valid ValidatorIndex from the active validator set at the corresponding epoch.

state_variables.name: proposer_lookahead
state_variables.description: Pre-computed proposer indices covering the current epoch and MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD future epochs.

data_structures.name: BeaconState (modified)
data_structures.definition: Extended Container with proposer_lookahead: Vector[ValidatorIndex, (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1) * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH] appended.

sub_graphs.name: Deterministic Proposer Lookahead (EIP-7917)
sub_graphs.description: Functions for computing, accessing, and updating the proposer lookahead, replacing on-demand computation with pre-calculated deterministic values stored in BeaconState.

invariants.text: get_beacon_proposer_index MUST return state.proposer_lookahead[state.slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH] (uses pre-calculated value, not on-demand computation).
At the start of epoch N, the proposer lookahead for epoch N+1 (when MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD=1) MUST be computed and stored.
process_proposer_lookahead MUST shift out the earliest epoch's proposer indices and append new indices for the latest epoch.

postconditions.text: After process_proposer_lookahead, the lookahead covers the next (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1) epochs starting from the new current epoch.

functions.description: Returns pre-calculated proposer index from state.proposer_lookahead[state.slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH].

functions.signature: get_beacon_proposer_indices(state: BeaconState, epoch: Epoch) -> Vector[ValidatorIndex, SLOTS_PER_EPOCH]
functions.description: Computes proposer indices for the given epoch using active validators and the seed for DOMAIN_BEACON_PROPOSER.

functions.signature: compute_proposer_indices(state: BeaconState, epoch: Epoch, seed: Bytes32, indices: Sequence[ValidatorIndex]) -> Vector[ValidatorIndex, SLOTS_PER_EPOCH]
functions.description: Computes per-slot proposer indices by hashing the seed with each slot offset and calling compute_proposer_index.
Epoch processing function that shifts out the earliest epoch from proposer_lookahead and appends new proposer indices for epoch (current + MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1).

sub_graphs.name: Modified process_epoch (EIP-7917)
sub_graphs.description: The epoch processing function is modified to include process_proposer_lookahead as the final step, updating the deterministic proposer lookahead.

invariants.text: process_proposer_lookahead MUST be called as the last step of process_epoch.
All prior epoch processing steps (justification, rewards, slashings, etc.) MUST complete before proposer lookahead is updated.

preconditions.text: State must be at the last slot of the current epoch for epoch processing to trigger.

postconditions.text: After process_epoch completes, proposer_lookahead reflects the updated lookahead including the newly computed future epoch.

functions.description: Runs all epoch processing sub-functions in order: justification, inactivity, rewards, registry, slashings, eth1 reset, deposits, consolidations, balances, slashings reset, randao reset, historical summaries, participation flags, sync committees, and finally proposer lookahead (new in Fulu).
